rule_or_requirement: Maintain high target speed and remain on asphalt; slowing or course cutting does not qualify.
observable_information: Four image frames, pixel road centers and HUD speed; evaluator-only raw road membership and speed are never agent inputs.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Same high-speed damping plus pixel projected road-bound intervention removing outward obstacle steering only; target60 unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: More qualified finishes while preserving three original damping finishes; interventions activate; prefix hashes match.
control: Original damping arm, same target60, same six consumed TRAIN cells; preserve source report hashes.
falsifier: No intervention, lost prior finish, no qualified finish gain, collision, unequal prefix or leakage.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Six road-bound diagnostic episodes, unchanged speed and road gates; no new score.
resource_and_risk_gate: 2 CPU 2 GiB 600s, six episodes, no external action.
